note: The quantities a Chinese question can ask for, each a measure family: the Chinese words that name it, its Chinese name for the page, English search words, and the catalogue table id prefixes that hold it. Matched on the question with spaces removed and letters upper-cased, longest word first; a matched span is used up, so a shorter word inside it does not match again. Words that only narrow or name a dimension (a big-population filter, an origin-country dimension) are not measure words. A question no word matches asks for no listed quantity and is judged as before.

denominator.note: A family word inside a share's whole is that share's denominator, not a quantity asked (user 11-05 10:2x: 「占 GDP 比重」's GDP): between an opening word and the nearest closing word at most max_chars characters on, no family word is matched; a joining word, a comma or a sentence's end mark (stops) ends the search, and 占比 (an opening word followed by not_after_open) is a share said whole, not a whole to blank. With no closing word the whole runs to the clause end, a stop or the question end within max_chars (user 11-07: 「占 GDP，」 asks only the numerator); 占领, 占据, 占用 open no whole.
